name: Zachary G. Meyer
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in New York, New York
about: Zachary G. Meyer is a partner at the law firm of Sutton Sachs Meyer PLLC in New York, New York. An accomplished business litigation attorney, Mr. Meyer serves clients throughout the state of New York. He also has experience with estate planning and general civil litigation.

Over the course of his legal career, Mr. Meyer has advised and litigated on behalf of business clients on the plaintiff and defense sides. He has substantial business law knowledge and guides his clients skillfully through the complex problems they often face. He is committed to resolving situations in a productive and efficient manner.

Earlier in his legal career, Mr. Meyer developed his legal knowledge and skills through a diverse range of roles. He is a former law clerk for the Supreme Court of the State of New York Second Judicial Department Appellate Division and practiced commercial litigation as an associate at another private law firm.

After earning a bachelor’s degree from Indiana University Bloomington Paul H. O’Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs, Mr. Meyer graduated from Hofstra University Maurice A. Deane School of Law. During law school, he served as senior articles editor of the law school’s Journal of International Business and Law and participated in the Community and Economic Development Clinic.

Mr. Meyer is qualified to practice law before the state courts of New York and New Jersey, the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern and Southern Districts of New York and the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey. Active in his local legal community, he belongs to the New York City Bar Association, serving on the association’s New York City Affairs Committee.
